In negative-zero-00, all 32 float32 outputs have bytes 00 00 00 00 instead of the required 00 00 00 80. The positive-zero control negative-zero-01 passes with all-zero bytes. Restrict null construction to non-floating dtypes; floating constants then use the existing dtype-specific constructors (or the existing fp8 conversion), preserving signed zero without changing nonzero construction.
